forward.description: 0-2: does every claim in the RESTATEMENT follow from the INPUT (no fact added the source does not support)? 2 = every restated claim is grounded in the input; 0 = the restatement asserts something the input never says. null when not scored.

backward.description: 0-2: does every claim in the INPUT appear in the RESTATEMENT (nothing the source stated is lost)? 2 = full coverage; 1 = partial; 0 = most of the input's meaning is missing. null when not scored.

rationale.description: One or two sentences justifying the scores.
